## Privacy & security review

- [ ] Adds or changes personal data fields; `Docs/data_map.md` is updated.
- [ ] Purpose, access controls, and retention/deletion behaviour are documented.
- [ ] Privacy notice or consent flow changes are included when needed.
- [ ] New processor, SDK, or API has been reviewed and the minimum data is shared.
- [ ] Personal data is not added to logs, URLs, analytics payloads, or test fixtures.
- [ ] Access, correction, export, and deletion paths cover the changed data.
